Name: Cat Deer Horse Replacement From The Legend Of Korra (Mula)
Author: v4410
Description:
[size=4][b]|| About ||
[/b][/size]
[i]• This mod replaces your horse to cat-deer Mula from The Legend Of Korra.
• Now there are two options, with and without a saddlebag, you can see the differences from the photos.
[/i]•Have fun with Mula :3

[b][size=4]|| Installation ||[/size]
[/b]
[i]1. Install [/i][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][i]2. Install [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
[i]3. Install the mod[/i]
[i]4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder[/i]
[i]5. Launch your game and enjoy :3![/i]
